description: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of runtime in seconds for different models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis displays the model names: “Our joint Framework”, “ChatGPT”, “DeepSeek”, “LLaMA”, and “Claude”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Runtime (seconds)”, presents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick marks at 50-second intervals. Two bars are present for each model, representing “Our joint Framework” in green and “LLM Models” in gray. For “Our joint Framework”, the bars have approximate heights of 77 seconds, 190 seconds, 172 seconds, 243 seconds, and 365 seconds, corresponding to the models listed on the horizontal axis. For “LLM Models”, the bars have approximate heights of 77 seconds, 190 seconds, 172 seconds, 243 seconds, and 365 seconds, corresponding to the models listed on the horizontal axis. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, with “Our joint Framework” appearing to the left of “LLM Models”. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
